job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.pay_full: US Zone 2: $193,500 – $261,900 a year; US Zone 3: $172,000 – $232,800 a year (not available in US Zone 1)

details.about: Dropbox's Product Security Engineering team reduces risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation and tooling that let engineers ship secure products with confidence. The team works with engineering and product teams across the software development lifecycle, embedding secure-by-default practices, and supports them with threat modeling, documentation and education.
duties: Build and maintain security tools, automation and libraries for secure-by-default development
Design and implement custom security rules (e.g. Semgrep, CodeQL) to catch common and emerging vulnerability patterns
Serve as an application security expert across web, mobile and desktop
Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle by building tools, checks and processes into engineering workflows
Do targeted code reviews and build follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions
Work with engineering, product, GRC and AI/ML teams to address security risks early
needs: 4+ years in application security or security engineering roles
Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security
Experience across the SDLC, including interpreting penetration test and bug bounty findings
Familiarity with microservices, CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native environments
Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g. injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and how to mitigate them
Comfort supporting multiple product and engineering teams at once
Incident response or security on-call experience is a plus
nice: Strong focus on security tooling and automation
Writing and maintaining custom security rules in developer workflows
Experience with machine learning systems, especially generative AI, and securing AI-driven products
Building internal libraries or frameworks that eliminate whole classes of vulnerabilities
Production-level code in one or more modern languages
Securing web, mobile and native applications
Data security tooling: data protection, access control and encryption
Strong communication and cross-team partnership skills
details.benefits: Base pay by US zone: Zone 2 $193,500 – $261,900 a year; Zone 3 $172,000 – $232,800 a year. The role is not available in US Zone 1.
notes: Many Dropbox teams run on-call rotations covering core and non-core hours; engineers on those teams take part

scenes.head: The role
lines: Now hiring, remote in select U S locations! Dropbox wants an Application Security Engineer for its Product Security Engineering team.

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll build security tools and automation, write custom detection rules in tools like Semgrep and CodeQL, and do targeted code reviews so engineers ship secure products.

scenes.head: What you need
lines: You'll need four years in application security or security engineering, hands-on security automation, and a solid grip on common flaws like injection and cross-site scripting.
Experience with penetration test and bug bounty findings matters too.
